description: Individual hardened packet derived from the 2026-09-03 holistic Kitty codebase review at base 70c15583a6afa4aac9a6f6eb11abf840afa377a4. It is intentionally separate from active ONE KITTY execution and is not applied by authoring this manifest.

packets.title: ChatGPT import is bounded and failures stay failures
packets.objective: Depend on KH-BODY-01. Stream the uploaded export directly to a private temporary file while enforcing the dedicated ChatGPT-import cap defined by the request-limit policy; do not accumulate the export in a Python bytes object. Validate filename/type and ensure temp cleanup on every branch. Treat extractor missing, timeout, nonzero exit, malformed output, and internal exceptions as typed failures with appropriate 4xx/5xx status rather than successful zero-item imports. Log technical stderr/exception detail internally; return only safe action-oriented copy. Preserve a legitimate successful result with zero extracted items as a distinct success state. Bound captured subprocess stdout/stderr or switch to an output file/stream so a malicious extractor result cannot create a second memory spike. Keep the extractor command argv-based and no shell.
acceptance_criteria: Upload bytes are streamed to disk under a documented cap rather than read into one in-memory bytes object.
Extractor missing, timeout, nonzero exit, malformed output, and unexpected exception are distinct failure responses and never HTTP-200 zero-item success.
A real successful import with zero findings remains a successful zero-item result.
Raw exception text, stack traces, subprocess stderr, file paths, and executable names are not primary user copy.
Temporary files are removed on success, rejection, timeout, cancellation, and exception.
validation_commands: python -m ruff check gateway/routes/import_chatgpt.py gateway/constants.py gateway/request_limits.py tests/test_import_chatgpt.py
